desc.p: Sends the activation mail of an account that is not active yet once more, with the same code (so an earlier mail stays valid). Only for applications the site's administrators allowed to register users, and only over HTTPS.
An account gets at most 3 resends, at least 5 minutes after the previous mail (the website itself sends the mail only once), so the method can't be used to flood an address with mail from the site.
Refusals give HTTP 400 with a reason: unknown_email, already_active, too_soon (the last mail went out less than 5 minutes ago), too_many_mails (3 resends already).

req.name: email
req.p: The email address the account was registered with.

opt.name: langpref
opt.p: Language of the mail, as in services/users/register.

returns.p: A dictionary with the email the mail was sent to.
